Jimmy Kimmel on Monday night tore into “mean, obnoxious creep” President Donald Trump after he “pulled a real disappearing act” as airlines across the nation grounded their fleets on Friday due to a massive technical problem.

“He didn’t post about it Friday or Saturday,” Kimmel said. “But he did find time to complain about the public golf course he’s trying to forcibly renovate in Washington.”

Trump posted dozens of images of D.C.’s East Potomac Park and Golf Links, a course he is trying to shut down and redevelop. His efforts there are being held up by legal challenges, which caused the president to throw a fit.

“He calls it ‘Trash Island,’” Kimmel noted. “He wrote, ‘Trash Island is currently the worst golf course anywhere in the world. The fairways are far too close together. When you walk down the corridors of Trash Island, you don’t hear the sound of the running Potomac. All you hear is the sound of people screaming, “FORE!”’”

Kimmel snarked that Trump may need to send in the National Guard to deal with the issue.

“You might be wondering with all that’s going on why the president is posting about ‘Trash Island,’” he said. “It’s very simple: Now that he can’t go to Epstein’s island, you know, he needs an island. He needs one island at all times.”
